users.title: User management
users.description: Manage login accounts, assigned roles, and account access.
users.createDescription: Create a login account and assign one or more roles.
users.editDescription: Update the account's profile, employee link, and roles.
users.employeeIdHint: Optional. When editing, leave blank to keep the existing employee link.
users.emptyDescription: User accounts returned by the server will appear here.
users.enableDescription: <bold>{{name}}</bold> will be able to sign in again.
users.deleteDescription: <bold>{{name}}</bold> will no longer be able to sign in. The account record and its audit history will be retained.
users.employeeHint: Their name, email and usual role are filled in for you.
users.noEmployeesAvailable: Every active employee already has an account. Add the employee in Personnel first.
users.usernameHint: First name + warehouse code. You can change it.

issued.title: Account created
issued.description: Give these to {{name}}. At first sign-in they will be asked to choose their own password.
issued.onceOnly: This password is shown only now. If it is lost, reset the password from the user’s page.

users.invitationNotice: The employee receives an email to confirm their address and choose their own password. Nobody else ever sees it.
